Title: Don Quijote's Cute Plum Candy Turned Out THIS Sour

Description:
Found this Umeboshi Sheet candy in the snack aisle at Don Quijote in Osaka. Inaba Peanuts, the maker behind it, has been in business since 1918 — over a hundred years making sweets from just plum, sugar, salt, and starch, sold at convenience stores across Japan. A plum pressed into a thin candy sheet is a format that simply doesn't exist in Korean plum products. Reviews are split: some say the cute packaging hides a surprisingly sour bite, others found it underwhelming — and supposedly, 1 in 10,000 sheets comes out heart-shaped.
